title: Board Session

filter.label: Filter the cards by Session name

manageFlagsTip: Manage the flags of this board

column.ownLock: Cannot drop here: own flags belong to each Project. Use right-click › Set flag.
column.emptyFlag: Drag a card here to set “{flag}”
column.emptyOwn: No Session with an own flag
column.blocked: {project} hides this flag: no drop here

card.waiting: Waiting for you to grant permission

banner.noFlags: No Session in {project} has a flag yet. Drag a card to a column, or right-click › Set flag.
banner.noFlagsAll: No Session has a flag yet. Drag a card to a column, or right-click › Set flag.

drag.mouse: Dragging “{name}” · drop on a column to change its flag; drop on No flag to remove the flag.
drag.keys: Keyboard: Space lifts a card · ← → choose a column · Space drops · Esc cancels.
drag.lifted: Lifted “{name}” · column: {column}. ← → choose a column, Space to drop, Esc to cancel.
drag.idle: Tab or ↑ ↓ choose a card · Enter opens it · Space lifts it to another column.
